args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

The file src/components/Toast.tsx implements the toast mechanism, where toasts use a polite aria-live region and disappear after a timeout of 5 seconds. This matches the issue description that error toasts are announced politely and vanish after 5 seconds, which is incorrect for errors. This file must change to make error toasts assertive and persistent until dismissed.
